how.title: How it works
how.description: From a street-level problem to an institutional response — in four clear steps.
how.step1Body: Describe the issue, add a photo, and pin the location on the map.
how.step2Body: The system suggests category, severity, and the right department.
how.step3Body: Staff are assigned and the report is tracked through to resolution.
how.step4Body: See status, updates, and results in real time.

Legal.updated: Updated: August 2026. This text is an informational outline, not legal advice.
Legal.disclaimer: This page is a draft for legal review. Do not treat it as a finalized legal document until municipal counsel has reviewed it.

privacy.collectBody: We collect data you provide (account, reports, messages) and technical data needed to run the platform (such as a session identifier).
privacy.reportsBody: Public reports show the description, category, location and photo of the issue. Your email and name are not shown on the public map or list.
privacy.accountBody: The account stores your name, email, hashed password (if used) and, where applicable, identity provider IDs.
privacy.locationBody: Location is used to place the report on the map and route it to the responsible institution. Browser GPS is requested only with your permission.
privacy.imagesBody: Report photos are stored with the configured media service (e.g. Cloudinary) and may be public as part of the report.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use an HttpOnly cookie for session refresh, plus local storage for theme, language and a session hint. We do not use advertising cookies.
privacy.authBody: If you sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook, we receive the provider ID, name and email (when the provider shares it). Apple may provide a private relay email. Client secrets are never exposed in the frontend.
privacy.retentionBody: Account and report data are kept while the account is active and as required for civic transparency and legal obligations. Exact periods must be set by legal review.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, correction or deletion of personal data, according to applicable law. Use the contact below for requests.
privacy.deletionBody: You may request account deletion. Public reports may remain in anonymized form if they are part of the civic record — this must be confirmed legally.
privacy.contactBody: Privacy: privacy@prizren.city (placeholder — replace with the official municipal contact).

terms.useBody: The platform is for reporting urban issues in Prizren. Use it in good faith and in accordance with the law.
terms.reportingBody: Report real infrastructure and public-service problems. Provide accurate information and relevant photos.
terms.prohibitedBody: Illegal content, hate, violence, third-party personal data, or material that infringes others’ rights is not allowed.
terms.falseBody: False or deceptive reports may lead to rejection, account suspension and, where applicable, legal consequences.
terms.abuseBody: Attacks, spam, abusive automation and attempts at unauthorized access are prohibited.
terms.accountBody: You are responsible for your password and activity on the account. Notify us immediately if you suspect misuse.
terms.publicBody: Reports (description, photo, location, status) may be publicly visible. Do not include unnecessary personal data.
terms.moderationBody: Staff may change status, assign an institution, mark duplicates or reject reports that violate these terms.
terms.availabilityBody: We aim to keep the service running, but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. Maintenance and outages may occur.
terms.terminationBody: We may close or limit accounts that violate these terms or that endanger the platform and the public.
terms.liabilityBody: The platform facilitates civic reporting; it does not replace emergency services. For immediate danger, call official services. Exact liability limits require legal review.
terms.contactBody: Terms: legal@prizren.city (placeholder — replace with the official contact).
